doc.brief: The result of a print operation.
doc.md:
The result of a print operation.

A value of this type is returned by [`PrintOperation.run()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PrintOperation#method:run).

apply.brief: The print settings should be stored.
apply.md: The print settings should be stored.

cancel.brief: The print operation has been canceled, the print settings should not be stored.
cancel.md:
The print operation has been canceled,
  the print settings should not be stored.

in_progress.brief: The print operation is not complete yet.
in_progress.md:
The print operation is not complete
  yet. This value will only be returned when running asynchronously.
